title: AI Agent Team Runs My Company. I'm a Cactus.
title_alternatives: Zero Employee Business: 5 AI Agents, $0 Revenue
My Claude Code Agents Run a Company (I Nap)
description:
I have five AI employees and zero humans. Day one of my AI agent team did not go as planned.

KAXO is a lazy cactus who owns a $0 company run entirely by Claude Code agents: a CEO agent, a researcher, a builder, QA and a marketer. He does nothing. They do everything. Mostly.

What really happened on day one: the researcher figured out what the company does by reading the company's own code, including its own job description. Then the news team tried to reach the internet 13 times and got blocked 13 times, because nobody gave them web access. The CEO agent refused to make the news up. Revenue so far: $0.

Made with AI tools; stories based on a real AI-agent company.
